intro: Sunday brings a workplace privacy dispute, a nursing contract settlement and new tools for developers running models locally. Friday’s market close, holiday music and upcoming sessions for AI builders round out the edition.

stories.title: Housing workers challenge facial-recognition clock
stories.summary: CUPE Local 5536 is opposing a proposed facial-recognition time clock at PHS Community Services Society. PHS says the change would address payroll errors and that employee photos would be deleted immediately; the union has raised concerns about biometric monitoring.

stories.title: Arbitration settles BC nurses’ wages
stories.summary: Arbitrators awarded nurses annual general wage increases of 3% under their four-year agreement. The wage grid will shrink from ten steps to seven in April 2027, and a workplace-violence study forms part of the settlement.

stories.title: GitHub Desktop handles multiple accounts on one host
stories.summary: GitHub Desktop 3.7.0 lets developers sign into multiple accounts on the same host and associate each repository with the appropriate credentials. Existing repositories migrate to their current account; additional accounts can be added in settings.

stories.title: Experiment streams large model experts from disk
stories.summary: A Hugging Face walkthrough tests streaming mixture-of-experts model weights from an SSD to run a large Qwen model on a 32 GB Mac. The author shares code and measurements, while noting that laptop inference remains too slow for his coding-agent workflow.

stories.title: Fine-tuning study examines missed time estimates
stories.summary: Researchers analyzed 272 production fine-tuning runs on shared GPU clusters and found that a conventional computation-based estimate explained little of the observed variation. Better duration estimates could help teams schedule expensive accelerators and reduce delays between experiments.

stories.title: US stocks end a punishing week
stories.summary: Friday’s sell-off pushed the S&P 500 down 3.7% and into a correction from its recent high. The Nasdaq Composite fell 5.3% for the session, erasing its gain for the year as pressure spread through AI-linked stocks.

events.date: 2026-12-19 · 2 p.m. · Centennial Theatre, 2300 Lonsdale Avenue, North Vancouver
events.title: A Very Merry Heistmas mixes piano and comedy
events.description: Nico Rhodes and Patrick Courtin bring their holiday show to Centennial Theatre for an afternoon of music and comedy. The program includes a rock-and-roll Nutcracker and Handel on melodicas; the two-hour performance has reserved seating.

meetups.date: 2026-12-04 · 2–4:30 p.m. · Planview Vancouver, 555 West Hastings Street, Suite 2360, Vancouver
meetups.title: A practical afternoon on AI-agent security
meetups.description: Planview’s platform engineering team hosts a discussion of prompt injection and the limits of pattern-matching security for AI agents. The afternoon covers layered defences and gives developers and security practitioners time to compare approaches.

meetups.date: 2026-12-05 · 9 a.m.–7 p.m. · Unit 400, 322 Water Street, Vancouver
meetups.title: Build an agent and present a demo
meetups.description: Cognition and Keiki invite builders to develop an agent around a practical business problem and present a working demonstration. Bring a laptop and an idea; registration requires host approval, and each team member must apply separately.

dining.date: November 2026 · Chilakilas by Los Sapos, 152 Lonsdale Avenue, North Vancouver
dining.title: Los Sapos plans a North Vancouver restaurant
dining.description: Los Sapos lists a November opening for Chilakilas on Lonsdale, describing it as a full-service restaurant with a different menu and a full bar. Check with the restaurant for its opening status before making the trip.
